channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Times Of Bangl[2]adesh[27][28][29][30] (tob.news)

item.title: Nation gears up to celebrate Independence Day
item.description: The day's events will commence with gun salutes in the early morning in Dhaka and all districts and upazilas.

item.title: Kim Kardashian-Lewis Hamilton spotted together amid dating rumours
item.description: Kim Kardashian and Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton sparked fresh speculation about their relationship during a recent outing in Tokyo.

item.title: Eid travels claim 87 lives nationwide
item.description: Eid day, 21 March, was no less tragic. At least 10 people were killed and over 25 injured in accidents across eight districts.

item.title: IMF seeks clear roadmap for financial reforms
item.description: The IMF seeks to ensure that the reform continuity remains under the new government and has requested a new roadmap to this effect.

item.title: BNP reschedules Independence Day event to Friday
item.description: BNP Chairman and Prime Minister Tarique Rahman will attend the event as the chief guest.

item.title: Power outage looms in early May
item.description: They also recommended expanding solar-based power generation to reduce costs as well as dependence on HFO-based plants.

item.title: Hiccups: A minor nuisance and how to stop them
item.description: Hiccups usually go away on their own without any treatment. However, some people have hiccups that go on much longer than normal.

item.title: 1,330 litres of stolen diesel seized in Noakhali, 2 held
item.description: Police seize 1,330 litres of stolen diesel in Hatiya, Noakhali and arrest two suspects in anti-hoarding drives.

item.title: Govt denies fake notice on office hours change
item.description: The fake notice claimed that office schedules were being adjusted to three days a week in an effort to save electricity and fuel.

item.title: Bangladesh seeks US waiver to import Russian fuel
item.description: Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman has urged the United States to provide Bangladesh with a special waiver allowing the import of refined diesel and other petroleum products from Russian sources, aiming to ease the country’s energy pressures.

item.title: Trader gets 10 days in jail over illegal diesel storage
item.description: The trader was jailed after failing to produce valid documents. Police, BGB officials, a UP member were present during the raid.

item.title: Rare 1,000-year-old Quran manuscript revealed in Saudi Arabia
item.description: More than 185 rare manuscripts on Quranic exegesis, in addition to hundreds of texts covering recitation, grammar, and interpretation.

item.title: Bangladesh drop to 181 in FIFA rankings
item.description: Bangladesh fall to 181 in FIFA rankings after losses to Vietnam and Singapore in the March international window, losing 9.18 ranking points.

item.title: 298 killed in road accidents during Eid journey
item.description: During the 15-day Eid travel period, 298 people died and over 2,000 were injured in 373 road accidents across Bangladesh.

item.title: Bangladesh edge Chinese Taipei 4-3 in Asian Games hockey qualifiers
item.description: Bangladesh edge Chinese Taipei 4-3 in the Asian Games hockey qualifiers in Thailand with strong penalty corner goals and a tense finish.
